hypotheses.title: Expert-flagged classes are more ambiguous than size-matched controls
hypotheses.statistic: mean filtered entropy H_f over the 21 flagged direct-parent classes
hypotheses.null: size-decile stratified permutation, R=10000; null mean 0.266 ± 0.142
hypotheses.detail: Pre-registered, run once. Effect +0.002 bits, 95% CI [-0.226, 0.331]. Only 4/21 flagged classes have any retained competitor; the positive controls Sesquiterpenoids/Diterpenoids score 0 on G_c. Unfiltered pilot reproduced: p=0.0102 (n=20, label-total deciles). Significant in 0/36 sweep cells. Exploratory: tree-free B-only score p=0.0001.

hypotheses.title: The overlay has more clustering and modularity than a degree-preserving null
hypotheses.statistic: Onnela weighted clustering (w_pmi) and Louvain modularity
hypotheses.detail: z(weighted clustering)=181.5, z(modularity)=134.2 (Q=0.954). Against a tree-constrained rewiring that keeps every edge inside its SubClass: z=13.3 and 19.5. p is the empirical minimum 1/(R+1).

hypotheses.title: Overlay communities are not a relabelling of the SuperClass partition
hypotheses.null: pre-registered threshold rule: supported iff NMI < 0.7 (no null distribution)
hypotheses.detail: Rule returns 'supported', but 0 of 171 communities cross a SuperClass and NMI vs SubClass is 0.983: with theta>=2 every edge stays inside one SuperClass, so the partition refines the tree by construction. On the tree-free B-only overlay NMI=0.383 and 7 of 7 communities cross a SuperClass.

errorProp.note: overlay = tree-free B-only competitors; on the primary A∩B every swap is 'none' by construction (θ=4)
